stories.title: Trump approves firing-squad execution for Fort Hood shooter, cancels livestream
stories.summary: President Trump overruled Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth's plan to broadcast the December execution of Nidal Hasan, the former Army major who killed 13 people at Fort Hood in 2009. The execution will still proceed by firing squad, with victims' immediate family allowed to attend.

stories.title: Trump rallies Nebraska voters as midterm push intensifies
stories.summary: Trump campaigned in Nebraska with GOP Senate candidate Pete Ricketts, part of a late push to defend Republican seats before next month's midterm elections. The rally came as the White House also faced a court order to pull taxpayer-funded promotional ads.

stories.title: Houthi missile strike on Yemen's presidential palace kills five
stories.summary: Ballistic missiles hit al-Maashiq Palace in Aden, killing at least five people, Yemen's information minister said; the prime minister and other ministers were unhurt. The attack is the latest in a widening exchange of strikes between the Houthis and Saudi-backed forces.

stories.title: Teen kills three children and a teacher at Bend, Oregon elementary school
stories.summary: A 16-year-old shot through locked doors at Silver Rail Elementary and killed three children and a teacher before a bystander followed him inside and shot him dead, police said. Two others were critically wounded and investigators have not identified a motive.

stories.title: YouTube Music adds labels for AI-generated content
stories.summary: YouTube Music now tags tracks it believes were made with AI, extending the platform's AI-disclosure rules from video to its streaming app. Listeners can see the label, but cannot yet filter AI tracks out of their feeds.

stories.title: Meta's new commercial terms open the door to scraping news sites
stories.summary: Legal experts say an upcoming Meta commercial terms update gives the company broad rights to scrape news publishers' sites, and virtually every newsroom holds a Meta business account. Publishers warn the change undercuts the licensing deals they have negotiated with AI companies.

stories.title: Amazon devices chief says AI devices will replace the need for apps
stories.summary: Panos Panay, who runs Amazon's devices group, argued that AI assistants will eventually make hunting through apps obsolete, with hardware doing the work for users. His comments preview Amazon's next wave of Alexa-driven products after a rocky stretch for the unit.

stories.title: Browns' injury picture improves ahead of Ravens matchup
stories.summary: Several key Browns starters moved in the right direction on Thursday's practice report after 11 players sat out Wednesday, a boost before Cleveland hosts Baltimore in Week 6. The Ravens added Zay Flowers and Mike Green to their own injury list Thursday.

stories.title: Cleveland's biggest concern through five weeks: a sputtering offense
stories.summary: A Cleveland-focused SI column argues the Browns' most pressing problem is an offense that cannot sustain drives, leaving too much work for a defense that has been the team's strength. Baltimore visits Cleveland on Sunday.

stories.title: No. 4 Ohio State favored on the road at No. 5 Indiana
stories.summary: ESPN's Week 7 top-25 betting lines make Ohio State a road favorite at Indiana in Saturday's rematch of last season's Big Ten Championship Game, while Notre Dame is a double-digit favorite at BYU. The Buckeyes are looking for revenge after the Hoosiers took last year's conference title.

stories.title: Keys to Ohio State-Indiana and what it means for the playoff race
stories.summary: USA Today frames Saturday's Ohio State-Indiana game (noon ET, Fox, Bloomington) as a clash that will settle Big Ten supremacy and shape the College Football Playoff picture. Ohio State leads the all-time series 81-13-5.

stories.title: Colapinto handed penalty for causing the Baku pile-up
stories.summary: Stewards penalized Alpine's Franco Colapinto for triggering the multi-car crash that eliminated Pierre Gasly and Lando Norris at the Azerbaijan Grand Prix. The incident overshadowed George Russell's win over Max Verstappen.

stories.title: Baku's late-race chaos nearly cost Russell the win over Verstappen
stories.summary: Autosport walks through the closing laps of the Azerbaijan Grand Prix, where late-race incidents and traffic briefly put George Russell's lead over Max Verstappen in doubt. Russell held on for a win that trims the gap at the top of the standings.

stories.title: Briatore to weigh action after Colapinto's "very poor" Baku move
stories.summary: Alpine advisor Flavio Briatore called Franco Colapinto's crash a "very poor" piece of driving and said the team will reflect on what action is needed. Colapinto has now been involved in multiple costly incidents this season.

stories.title: Norris calls for a ban on Colapinto after Azerbaijan GP crash
stories.summary: Lando Norris said Franco Colapinto should face a suspension after the Alpine driver's error took both of them out of the Azerbaijan Grand Prix. Norris' race ended on the spot while Colapinto continued to be a talking point in the paddock.

stories.title: Tarkov Arena goes offline for patch 0.6.1
stories.summary: Battlestate Games took Escape from Tarkov: Arena offline early Friday to install patch 0.6.1, with maintenance expected to run about four hours from 3 a.m. ET (8 a.m. BST). The update follows the team's posted Q4 2026 Arena plan of new content alongside technical fixes.

stories.title: "Scourge Incursion" event launches on The Lab
stories.summary: A new Escape from Tarkov event drops a heavily armed unidentified squad into the TerraGroup complex on The Lab, running through October 20 at 7 a.m. UTC. Rumors link the squad's commander to the Arena champions, an identity Battlestate has not confirmed.

stories.title: Bayer to build $2.2 billion manufacturing plant in New Albany
stories.summary: Bayer plans a pharmaceutical manufacturing campus in the New Albany International Business Park, a project state officials say brings about 1,500 construction jobs and more than 600 permanent positions. JobsOhio is putting up to $30 million behind the site as Ohio courts more life-sciences investment.

stories.title: Caleb Flynn sentenced to life without parole for killing his wife
stories.summary: An Ohio judge sentenced Caleb Flynn to life in prison without the possibility of parole after his conviction for murdering his wife, ending a case that drew attention across the state.

stories.title: Juvenile seriously injured after falling from roof of moving car
stories.summary: A juvenile was seriously injured in Columbus after falling from the roof of a moving vehicle, police said. No further details on the circumstances were released.
